ITEM 1 | Small oval nuts, about 2 to 2.5 cm long and 1 to 1.5 cm wide, with smooth light-brown skins, slightly darker at the edges, dry matte surface with no sheen or moisture, holding firm shape, scattered in a loose cluster across the center and right side of a white foam plate about 20 cm across, with faint pinkish and yellowish residue on the plate beneath them | 45

ITEM 2 | Pale pinkish-red smudges and faint yellow stains on the white plate surface around the nuts, flat and dried with no visible pooling or sheen, sitting between and beneath the nut pieces | 2
